passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites to turn back and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. You are to encamp by the sea, directly opposite Baal-zephon.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD told Moses to tell the Israelites to turn back.
The LORD told Moses to tell the Israelites to camp in front of Pi-hahiroth.
Pi-hahiroth is between Migdol and the sea.
The LORD told Moses to tell the Israelites to camp by the sea.
The LORD told Moses to tell the Israelites to camp directly opposite Baal-zephon.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְיָשֻׁ֗בוּ וְיַחֲנוּ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת בֵּ֥ין מִגְדֹּ֖ל וּבֵ֣ין הַיָּ֑ם לִפְנֵי֙ בַּ֣עַל צְפֹ֔ן נִכְח֥וֹ תַחֲנ֖וּ עַל־ הַיָּֽם׃

passages.text: For Pharaoh will say of the Israelites, ‘They are wandering the land in confusion; the wilderness has boxed them in.’
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh saw the Israelites.
Pharaoh said, “The Israelites are confused.”
Pharaoh said, “They are wandering in the land.”
Pharaoh said, “The wilderness has trapped them.”
passages.original: וְאָמַ֤ר פַּרְעֹה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְבֻכִ֥ים הֵ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ סָגַ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart so that he will pursue them. But I will gain honor by means of Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD.” So this is what the Israelites did.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said He would harden Pharaoh’s heart.
Pharaoh is the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh would chase after the Israelites.
The LORD would gain honor through Pharaoh and all his army.
The Egyptians would know that the LORD is God.
The Israelites did what the LORD commanded.
passages.original: וְחִזַּקְתִּ֣י אֶת־ לֵב־ פַּרְעֹה֮ וְרָדַ֣ף אַחֲרֵיהֶם֒ וְאִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּפַרְעֹה֙ וּבְכָל־ חֵיל֔וֹ וְיָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵֽן׃

passages.text: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, “What have we done? We have released Israel from serving us.”
passages.sermon:
The king of Egypt is Pharaoh.
Pharaoh ruled over Egypt.
Someone told Pharaoh that the Israelites had fled.
The Israelites were slaves in Egypt.
Pharaoh and his officials heard this news.
Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about the Israelites.
Pharaoh and his officials said, “What have we done?”
Pharaoh and his officials realized they had let Israel go free.
Pharaoh and his officials said, “We have released Israel from serving us.”
passages.original: וַיֻּגַּד֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י בָרַ֖ח הָעָ֑ם וַ֠יֵּהָפֵךְ לְבַ֨ב פַּרְעֹ֤ה וַעֲבָדָיו֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם וַיֹּֽאמרוּ֙ מַה־ זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־ שִׁלַּ֥חְנוּ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵעָבְדֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: So Pharaoh prepared his chariot and took his army with him.
passages.sermon: Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.\r\nPharaoh prepared his chariot.\r\nPharaoh took his army with him.
passages.original: וַיֶּאְסֹ֖ר אֶת־ רִכְבּ֑וֹ וְאֶת־ עַמּ֖וֹ לָקַ֥ח עִמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He took 600 of the best chariots, and all the other chariots of Egypt, with officers over all of them.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh prepared to pursue the Israelites.
Pharaoh took 600 of the best chariots.
Pharaoh also took all the other chariots of Egypt.
Pharaoh put officers in charge of every chariot.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֗ח שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת רֶ֙כֶב֙ בָּח֔וּר וְכֹ֖ל רֶ֣כֶב מִצְרָ֑יִם וְשָׁלִשִׁ֖ם עַל־ כֻּלּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt so that he pursued the Israelites, who were marching out defiantly.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acted with power.
The LORD made Pharaoh’s heart stubborn.
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh decided to chase the Israelites.
The Israelites were leaving Egypt.
The Israelites marched out boldly.
passages.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֣ק יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶת־ לֵ֤ב פַּרְעֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּרְדֹּ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֹצְאִ֖ים בְּיָ֥ד רָמָֽה׃

passages.text: The Egyptians—all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots, horsemen and troops—pursued the Israelites and overtook them as they camped by the sea near Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon.
passages.sermon:
The Egyptians chased the Israelites.
Pharaoh led the Egyptians.
Pharaoh had many horses.
Pharaoh had many chariots.
Pharaoh had horsemen.
Pharaoh had troops.
The Egyptians caught up to the Israelites.
The Israelites were camped by the sea.
They camped near Pi-hahiroth.
Pi-hahiroth was opposite Baal-zephon.
passages.original: וַיִּרְדְּפ֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם וַיַּשִּׂ֤יגוּ אוֹתָם֙ חֹנִ֣ים עַל־ הַיָּ֔ם כָּל־ סוּס֙ רֶ֣כֶב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וּפָרָשָׁ֖יו וְחֵיל֑וֹ עַל־ פִּי֙ הַֽחִירֹ֔ת לִפְנֵ֖י בַּ֥עַל צְפֹֽן׃

passages.text: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up and saw the Egyptians marching after them, and they were terrified and cried out to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh came closer to the Israelites.
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
The Israelites lifted their eyes.
They saw the Egyptians coming after them.
The Egyptians were marching behind the Israelites.
The Israelites became very afraid.
The Israelites cried out to the LORD.
passages.original: וּפַרְעֹ֖ה הִקְרִ֑יב וַיִּשְׂאוּ֩ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת־ עֵינֵיהֶ֜ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה מִצְרַ֣יִם׀ נֹסֵ֣עַ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם וַיִּֽירְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: They said to Moses, “Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us into the wilderness to die? What have you done to us by bringing us out of Egypt?
passages.sermon:
The Israelites spoke to Moses.
They said, "Were there no graves in Egypt?"
"Did you bring us out here to die in the wilderness?"
"What have you done to us?"
"Why did you bring us out of Egypt?"
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֒ הַֽמִבְּלִ֤י אֵין־ קְבָרִים֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם לְקַחְתָּ֖נוּ לָמ֣וּת בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר מַה־ זֹּאת֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔נוּ לְהוֹצִיאָ֖נוּ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Did we not say to you in Egypt, ‘Leave us alone so that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites spoke to Moses.
They said these words to Moses while they were in Egypt.
They said, “Leave us alone.
Let us serve the Egyptians.
It is better for us to serve the Egyptians.
It is better than dying in the wilderness.”
passages.original: הֲלֹא־ זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבַּ֨רְנוּ אֵלֶ֤יךָ בְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר חֲדַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וְנַֽעַבְדָ֣ה אֶת־ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לָ֙נוּ֙ עֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִמֻּתֵ֖נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: But Moses told the people, “Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the LORD’s salvation, which He will accomplish for you today; for the Egyptians you see today, you will never see again.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people.
He said, "Do not be afraid."
He said, "Stand firm."
He said, "You will see the LORD’s salvation today."
The LORD will accomplish this salvation for you today.
You see the Egyptians today.
You will never see them again.
You will not see them ever again.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶל־ הָעָם֮ אַל־ תִּירָאוּ֒ הִֽתְיַצְב֗וּ וּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ יְשׁוּעַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר רְאִיתֶ֤ם אֶת־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹ֥א תֹסִ֛יפוּ לִרְאֹתָ֥ם ע֖וֹד עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD will fight for you.
You must be silent.
You must be still.
passages.original: יְהוָ֖ה יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָכֶ֑ם וְאַתֶּ֖ם תַּחֲרִישֽׁוּן׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Why are you crying out to Me? Tell the Israelites to go forward.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD asked Moses, “Why are you crying out to Me?”
The LORD commanded Moses, “Speak to the Israelites.”
The LORD told Moses, “Tell the Israelites to move forward.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה מַה־ תִּצְעַ֖ק אֵלָ֑י דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְיִסָּֽעוּ׃

passages.text: And as for you, lift up your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it, so that the Israelites can go through the sea on dry ground.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses a command.
God told Moses to lift up his staff.
God told Moses to stretch out his hand over the sea.
God told Moses to divide the sea.
God wanted the Israelites to walk through the sea.
God made a path of dry ground for the Israelites in the middle of the sea.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה הָרֵ֣ם אֶֽת־ מַטְּךָ֗ וּנְטֵ֧ה אֶת־ יָדְךָ֛ עַל־ הַיָּ֖ם וּבְקָעֵ֑הוּ וְיָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּ֖ם בַּיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: And I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they will go in after them. Then I will gain honor by means of Pharaoh and all his army and chariots and horsemen.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians.
The Egyptians will chase after the Israelites.
I will gain honor through Pharaoh.
I will gain honor through all Pharaoh’s army.
I will gain honor through Pharaoh’s chariots.
I will gain honor through Pharaoh’s horsemen.”
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנְנִ֤י מְחַזֵּק֙ אֶת־ לֵ֣ב מִצְרַ֔יִם וְיָבֹ֖אוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְאִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּפַרְעֹה֙ וּבְכָל־ חֵיל֔וֹ בְּרִכְבּ֖וֹ וּבְפָרָשָֽׁיו׃

passages.text: The Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I am honored through Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen.”
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God will act with power and glory.
God will show His honor through Pharaoh.
God will show His honor through Pharaoh’s chariots.
God will show His honor through Pharaoh’s horsemen.
The Egyptians will see these things.
The Egyptians will know that God is the LORD.
passages.original: וְיָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּהִכָּבְדִ֣י בְּפַרְעֹ֔ה בְּרִכְבּ֖וֹ וּבְפָרָשָֽׁיו׃

passages.text: And the angel of God, who had gone before the camp of Israel, withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from before them and stood behind them, so that it came between the camps of Egypt and Israel. The cloud was there in the darkness, but it lit up the night. So all night long neither camp went near the other.
passages.sermon:
The angel of God had gone before the camp of Israel.
The angel of God moved and went behind the camp of Israel.
The pillar of cloud had been in front of the Israelites.
The pillar of cloud moved and stood behind them.
The pillar of cloud came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel.
The cloud brought darkness.
The cloud gave light during the night.
All night long, the Egyptians and the Israelites did not come near each other.
passages.original: וַיִּסַּ֞ע מַלְאַ֣ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים הַהֹלֵךְ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּסַּ֞ע עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽעָנָן֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּֽעֲמֹ֖ד מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃ וַיָּבֹ֞א בֵּ֣ין׀ מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֗יִם וּבֵין֙ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְהִ֤י הֶֽעָנָן֙ וְהַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וַיָּ֖אֶר אֶת־ הַלָּ֑יְלָה וְלֹא־ קָרַ֥ב זֶ֛ה אֶל־ זֶ֖ה כָּל־ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃

passages.text: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land. So the waters were divided, and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses stretched out his hand over the sea.
The LORD acted with power.
The LORD sent a strong east wind all night.
The LORD drove back the sea with this wind.
The LORD turned the sea into dry land.
The waters divided.
The Israelites went through the sea.
They walked on dry ground.
The water stood like a wall on their right side.
The water stood like a wall on their left side.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨ט מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶת־ יָדוֹ֮ עַל־ הַיָּם֒ וַיּ֣וֹלֶךְ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֶת־ הַ֠יָּם בְּר֨וּחַ קָדִ֤ים עַזָּה֙ כָּל־ הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם לֶחָרָבָ֑ה וַיִּבָּקְע֖וּ הַמָּֽיִם׃ וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּ֖ם בַּיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וְהַמַּ֤יִם לָהֶם֙ חֹמָ֔ה מִֽימִינָ֖ם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָֽם׃

passages.text: And the Egyptians chased after them—all Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen—and followed them into the sea.
passages.sermon:
The Egyptians chased the Israelites.
Pharaoh led the Egyptians.
Pharaoh had many horses.
Pharaoh had many chariots.
Pharaoh had many horsemen.
All of Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen followed the Israelites.
They went into the sea after the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיִּרְדְּפ֤וּ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֚ל ס֣וּס פַּרְעֹ֔ה רִכְבּ֖וֹ וּפָרָשָׁ֑יו אֶל־ תּ֖וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃

passages.text: At morning watch, however, the LORD looked down on the army of the Egyptians from the pillar of fire and cloud, and He threw their camp into confusion.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD used a pillar of fire and a pillar of cloud to guide Israel.
At the morning watch, the LORD looked down from the pillar of fire and cloud.
He looked at the army of the Egyptians.
The LORD threw the Egyptian camp into confusion.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בְּאַשְׁמֹ֣רֶת הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּשְׁקֵ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּעַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ וְעָנָ֑ן וַיָּ֕הָם אֵ֖ת מַחֲנֵ֥ה מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: He caused their chariot wheels to wobble, so that they had difficulty driving. “Let us flee from the Israelites,” said the Egyptians, “for the LORD is fighting for them against Egypt!”
passages.sermon:
God acted against the Egyptians.
God made the chariot wheels of the Egyptians wobble.
The Egyptians could not drive their chariots easily.
The Egyptians said, “Let us flee from the Israelites.”
The Egyptians said, “The LORD is fighting for the Israelites against Egypt.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֗סַר אֵ֚ת אֹפַ֣ן מַרְכְּבֹתָ֔יו וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֖הוּ בִּכְבֵדֻ֑ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מִצְרַ֗יִם אָנ֙וּסָה֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה נִלְחָ֥ם לָהֶ֖ם בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots and horsemen.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “Stretch out your hand over the sea.”
The LORD commanded Moses to act.
The LORD wanted the waters to return over the Egyptians.
The LORD wanted the waters to cover the Egyptians’ chariots.
The LORD wanted the waters to cover the Egyptians’ horsemen.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה נְטֵ֥ה אֶת־ יָדְךָ֖ עַל־ הַיָּ֑ם וְיָשֻׁ֤בוּ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ עַל־ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַל־ רִכְבּ֖וֹ וְעַל־ פָּרָשָֽׁיו׃

passages.text: So Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea returned to its normal state. As the Egyptians were retreating, the LORD swept them into the sea.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses stretched out his hand over the sea.
It was almost morning.
The sea returned to its normal state.
The Egyptians were running away from the sea.
The LORD swept the Egyptians into the sea.
passages.original: וַיֵּט֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת־ יָד֜וֹ עַל־ הַיָּ֗ם וַיָּ֨שָׁב הַיָּ֜ם לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּ֙קֶר֙ לְאֵ֣יתָנ֔וֹ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם נָסִ֣ים לִקְרָאת֑וֹ וַיְנַעֵ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃

passages.text: The waters flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen—the entire army of Pharaoh that had chased the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them survived.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh’s army chased the Israelites into the sea.
The waters returned to their place.
The waters covered the chariots.
The waters covered the horsemen.
The waters covered all of Pharaoh’s army.
None of Pharaoh’s army survived.
passages.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ הַמַּ֗יִם וַיְכַסּ֤וּ אֶת־ הָרֶ֙כֶב֙ וְאֶת־ הַפָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים לְכֹל֙ חֵ֣יל פַּרְעֹ֔ה הַבָּאִ֥ים אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם בַּיָּ֑ם לֹֽא־ נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּהֶ֖ם עַד־ אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: But the Israelites had walked through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
They walked through the sea.
They walked on dry ground.
Water stood like a wall on their right side.
Water stood like a wall on their left side.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיָּ֑ם וְהַמַּ֤יִם לָהֶם֙ חֹמָ֔ה מִֽימִינָ֖ם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָֽם

passages.text: That day the LORD saved Israel from the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the shore.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acted that day.
The LORD saved Israel.
The LORD rescued Israel from the Egyptians.
Israel saw the Egyptians.
The Egyptians lay dead on the shore.
passages.original: וַיּ֨וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֜ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֛וּא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיַּ֤רְא יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵ֖ת עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיָּֽם׃

passages.text: When Israel saw the great power that the LORD had exercised over the Egyptians, the people feared the LORD and believed in Him and in His servant Moses.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel saw the great power of the LORD.
The LORD had acted against the Egyptians.
The people feared the LORD.
The people believed in the LORD.
The people believed in Moses, His servant.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨רְא יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ הַיָּ֣ד הַגְּדֹלָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּֽאֲמִ֙ינוּ֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וּבְמֹשֶׁ֖ה עַבְדּֽוֹ׃פ
